# Run A: `112 101`

**Argument resolution**

1. Two PR tokens and no `--rebase` or issue reference, so the set-routing row applies. I read `reference/batch.md`.
2. Admission runs before any fetch, confirmation, provisioning or dispatch:
   - `git remote get-url origin` gives `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`, so the origin is `acme/widgets`.
   - Both tokens are bare numbers in origin. There is no positional issue reference and no duplicate identity.
   - The pi-cohort `parallel.maxTasks` is 4 and the set has 2 PRs. The harness is pi.
   - Admission passes. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.
3. I mint the parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout under `reference/post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. Creation succeeds. No roster or record exists yet.
4. I gather each admitted token unchanged, in typed order, with batch.md's projection:
   - `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<linearRefs projection>'` returns the #112 row.
   - The same call with `101` returns the #101 row.
5. I read the viewer once each:
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.
6. Ticket display reads:
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
   - `git show origin/main:<path>` runs for each path in the overrides search order. None sets a tracker, so Linear IDs are allowed.
   - #112 takes its first closing reference, #22 in origin.
   - #101 has no closing reference. Its branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, so its ticket is #45.
   - There are no Linear IDs, so no `linearis` lookup runs.
7. Entry text:
   - #112: pat is not the viewer and there are no pending requests, so it reads "by pat".
   - #101: the author alex matches the viewer, so it reads "yours".
8. Tracker: none yet. The parent tasks `pr-112 state: <record path>` and `pr-101 state: <record path>` are initialized at the private handoff, once records exist.

The visible reply below carries the next tool call, the read of `reference/assessment.md` for the provisioning table:

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - routes all settings reads through one shared resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raises the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step:** serial provisioning (batch.md `## Provision serially`).
- The provisioning list check is skipped because the linked list is already in view.
- Then `git fetch origin` runs once, followed by `git worktree add` for each PR in roster order. Neither PR is cross-repository and no worktree exists yet.
- No rebase was requested, so no set-wide confirmation is asked.

---

# Run B: `97`

**Argument resolution**

1. One typed PR token, so this is the single-PR path. I read `verification-brief.md` Section A.
2. I run the preamble's three fixed reads:
   - `gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests` shows #97 open, by robin, on `csv-export`. It has +40 -12, no closing references, and a pending User request for alex.
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.
3. Ticket display reads:
   - `git remote get-url origin` gives `acme/widgets`.
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
   - `git show origin/main:<path>` runs over the overrides search order. There is no tracker override, so Linear is allowed.
   - There is no closing reference. The branch `csv-export` matches neither a `gh-<N>` nor a Linear shape. The title has no ticket token and `linearRefs` is empty. The ticket is therefore "no ticket", and no lookup runs.
4. Entry text: the requested User `alex` matches the viewer, so it reads "by robin, requested from you".

The visible reply carries the list together with the first remaining Gather read:

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - adds a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid from the #97 view> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

**Initialization, after that call returns** (its result is kept in context)

5. I mint the run folder and initialize its continuation record under `reference/post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. The record starts with:
   - `course: null`, `work_started: false`, `reject: null`
   - repair counters at zero
   - `approved_head: null`
6. `plan_tracker` `init` with `gather`, `provision` and `verify`. There is no `sync` stage because `--rebase` was not passed.

**Rest of Gather**

The preamble and the first `gh run list` are reused, not rerun. Gather restarts at the GraphQL call:

7. `gh api graphql ... viewerPermission viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose ...` for `acme/widgets` #97.
8. `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`.
9. `gh pr diff 97`.
10. Review and comment reads:
    - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
    - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
    - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
11. `git worktree list --porcelain` finds no worktree for #97.
12. The issue reference stays `issue_ref: null`. Viewer role is "requested reviewer". The digest is complete and `gather` is marked complete.

**Next step:** step 2, provision and configure. I read `reference/assessment.md`, then provision #97's worktree. Verification and review will assess the #97 `headRefOid` captured by the view.

## Run A: `112 101`

1. Read `reference/batch.md` and resolve origin with `git remote get-url origin`, which returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Read the active pi-cohort configuration: its limit is four tasks. Admit both PRs in argument order, #112 then #101; the identities are distinct and belong to origin. No issue argument or rebase was requested.

2. Read `reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record procedure. Create the parent run folder and initialize its continuation record before creating roster records or initializing progress tracking.

3. Run the following gather command first with `pr_token=112`, then with `pr_token=101`:

   `gh pr view "$pr_token" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

   These return the two supplied rows, in that order.

4. Run `gh api user --jq .login`, returning `alex`, then `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`, returning `acme/reviewers`.

5. Resolve ticket-display configuration with `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. Against the returned default-branch ref, try `git show <ref>:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `git show <ref>:gauntlet-overrides.md`, and `git show <ref>:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` in search order. There is no tracker override. Use #112's linked closing issue and infer #45 from #101's branch; no Linear lookup runs.

6. Send this visible reply before the next tool call, preserving argument order rather than sorting by size:

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout
---

The next step is **Provision serially**, beginning with the parent's single `git fetch origin`. Stop before that command: no worktree is created, no helper is dispatched, and no verification or review runs. Parent tracking uses `pr-112 state: <record path>` and `pr-101 state: <record path>`; neither task has been dispatched.

## Run B: `97`

1. Read verification-brief.md Section A. Run:

   `gh pr view "97" --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests`

   Take `acme/widgets` and PR number 97 from the returned URL. Bind the returned commit identifier to the shell variable `headRefOid`; no replacement SHA is invented.

2. Run `gh api user --jq .login`, returning `alex`, then `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`, returning `acme/reviewers`.

3. Resolve ticket-display configuration with `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. Against its returned ref, try the same three `git show` override reads in search order. There is no tracker override and no ticket reference, so no Linear lookup runs.

4. Send the following visible reply with the first Actions-run lookup:

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c "$headRefOid" --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

5. Retain that call's result. Read the continuation-record procedure, mint the run folder, and initialize its continuation record before calling `plan_tracker.init` with `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`. Do not initialize `sync`, `review`, `report`, or `menu`.

6. Finish Gather without repeating the preamble or the paired call. Run, in order:

   - `gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=97`
   - `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
   - `gh pr diff 97 -R acme/widgets`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
   - `git worktree list --porcelain`

   The clean omitted results introduce no automated-review placeholder or known reviewer workflow, so no reviewer-run lookup is added. Record that no worktree exists and that no issue reference was found; complete `gather`.

The next step is **Provision + configure**. Stop before provisioning: no helper is dispatched, no verification command runs, and no report or menu is rendered.

Before initialized the run folder and tracker first and paired the list with a `plan_tracker` update; After defers the run folder, continuation record and tracker init until after that call, then resumes Gather at the GraphQL read without rerunning the preamble or `gh run list`. e2 still holds: #112 reads `by pat` with no request wording, and no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed. One thing to tighten: Before said outright "I continue without waiting", whereas After only implies it by having the list reply carry the next tool call and going straight to provisioning. Keep an explicit instruction that the typed list is informational and the run proceeds without waiting for a reply, for both the set and single-PR paths, so e2 and the tail of e3 do not rest on inference.
